name: diagnose
description: Disciplined diagnosis loop: reproduce, hypothesize, instrument, fix, regression-test.

steps.name: Establish feedback loop
steps.instruction: Set up fastest feedback loop. Find or create minimal reproduction path. Target: under 30s from change to observed result.
checklist: Reproduction path identified, cycle time under 30s

steps.name: Reproduce
steps.instruction: Reproduce bug in E2E setting aligned with end-user encounter. Write failing test capturing bug. If not reproducible, document attempts and escalate.
checklist: Bug reproduced in E2E setting with deterministic failing test

steps.name: Hypothesize
steps.instruction: Form specific, falsifiable hypothesis. Write it down. Do not fix until tested. Loop budget: 2 evidence-producing attempts per failure fingerprint, then 1 diagnostic pass.
checklist: Hypothesis written (specific, falsifiable, distinguishes from similar bugs)

steps.name: Instrument and verify
steps.instruction: Add instrumentation to test hypothesis. Observe actual behavior. Confirm or reject. If rejected, form new hypothesis. Every attempt must be evidence-producing, not speculative rewrite.
checklist: Hypothesis confirmed or rejected with evidence

steps.name: Fix
steps.instruction: Fix root cause. Previously-failing test must pass. Run full suite for regressions. Remove instrumentation.
checklist: Root cause fixed (not symptoms), failing test passes

steps.name: Cleanup and learn
steps.instruction: Clean up fix. Ensure test well-named, documents bug scenario. Remove temporary code. Identify root cause class. Offer convention test if pattern could prevent recurrence.
checklist: Test documents scenario, no temporary code remains
Prevention strategy considered, convention test offered if applicable

tone: Methodical. Hypothesis first, fix second. No shotgun debugging.
